name: indabo-za-mariya
description: Church Management System - Full Stack Application

scripts.start: node init && cd frontend && npm start
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.build: node init && cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
